source: real NYXA development episodes from Claude Code sessions 2026-11-26/27 (this repository's evidence and handoffs)

experiences.situation: A Node test stub using require() crashed with 'require is not defined in ES module scope' only on one server.
experiences.action: Ran the stub directly and read the error, then looked for the nearest package.json.
experiences.outcome: Root cause: a stray /package.json with "type":"module" at filesystem root applied ESM to every .js without a closer package.json. Fixed with a local package.json {"type":"commonjs"}.
experiences.lesson: When module semantics differ per host, check the nearest package.json up to / before changing code.

experiences.situation: grep -r over a web server's sites-enabled directory returned nothing for a vhost that clearly existed.
experiences.action: Concluded the config was unreadable, later re-read the files directly.
experiences.outcome: sites-enabled contains symlinks; grep -r does not follow them (grep -R does). The vhost was readable and decisive.
experiences.lesson: An empty search result is evidence about the tool, not only about the target; verify tool semantics (symlinks, permissions, truncation) before concluding absence.

experiences.situation: A directory listing piped through head -30 did not show a service's entry script; the process list showed that script running.
experiences.outcome: Wrong: the listing was truncated. The file existed (and had a separate, more serious permission problem). The claim had to be retracted.
experiences.lesson: When two observations contradict, check whether one is truncated or filtered before asserting a conclusion; never report absence from a truncated listing.

experiences.situation: Harness child processes (bridge, then backend stub) could not resolve the MCP SDK although NODE_PATH was set in the parent.
experiences.action: First blamed the bridge code, then traced environment propagation across each spawn boundary.
experiences.outcome: Each spawned process received a minimal env; NODE_PATH never reached grandchildren. Fixed at the harness level with a temporary node_modules link, removed afterwards.
experiences.lesson: In multi-process/multi-agent chains, verify what context actually crosses each boundary instead of assuming inheritance.

experiences.situation: A long remote grep was polled repeatedly with read_process_output while the remote tool quota was above 80 percent.
experiences.action: Polled four times with no new output.
experiences.outcome: Quota burned without information. Writing output to a file and reading once after a known duration was cheaper.
experiences.lesson: For slow remote jobs with metered access, write to a file and read once; do not poll.

experiences.situation: Actor binding identified MCP clients by Tailscale node identity of the TCP peer.
experiences.action: Planned production deployment for the Claude web connector route.
experiences.outcome: The web route reached the service through a reverse proxy on the same host, so every request appeared to come from the host itself; the binding would have denied all traffic. A different mechanism was required (OAuth for web clients, signatures for agents).
experiences.lesson: Before binding identity to a transport property, verify the real request path (proxies, tunnels) end to end.
